sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS The reciprocal stockholder expects to use the net proceeds from its sale of any shares of common stock pursuant to this prospectus supplement for general corporate purposes, which may include, but is not limited to, strengthening the Reciprocal's admitted surplus position, improving liquidity and asset diversification, financing acquisitions, otherwise meeting applicable regulatory requirements and maintaining its financial stability rating, or paying claims and expenses. For more information about the Reciprocal, see the section titled “Selling Stockholders” in the accompanying prospectus. In addition, we intend to use the net proceeds  we receive upon our issuance and sale of shares of our common stock for general corporate purposes. sections.excerpt: RISK FACTORS Investing in our common stock involves risks. You should also consider the risk factors described in any documents we incorporate by reference in the future.
